build.reason: The supplied recipe builds the xinclude object and links it with libxml2; the delegated configure defaults enable XInclude and XPointer because the recipe selects no disabling option. This assesses the recipe, not an unprovided build result.

input.reason: Fuzzer bytes supply options, an allocation index, URL/entity pairs and the main XML buffer; the entity loader resolves supplied URLs from that table.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes parser and allocator hooks, creates and frees parser, XInclude and document objects on its normal path, then clears the allocation limit and fuzz data; the XInclude context destructor accepts NULL.

control_flow.reason: The entry calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode with the document cast to xmlNodePtr. That function returns before root processing if node->doc is NULL; the packet does not show the returned document's doc field. This is decisive for the changed XInclude routes.

missing_information: The value of the doc field in the xmlDocPtr returned by xmlCtxtReadMemory when the OLD entry casts it to xmlNodePtr and calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode.
